name: Go-Getter
text: Once per game: take an extra turn after this one.

name: Late Riser
text: Round Start: if you have the fewest followers (ties count), take an extra turn before anyone places.

name: Courier
text: Whenever you take an extra turn, +1 of each other color.

name: Clockmaker
text: On Recruit: +1 purple per 2 purple you have. Round Start: +1 purple per 2 purple you have.

name: Night Owl
text: Once per round: after you place your last minion, take an extra turn.

name: Bouncer
text: On Recruit: the next two rivals’ turns are skipped.

name: Gossip
text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 follower.

name: Timekeepers
text: Game end: +1 follower per purple member you have.

name: Closer
text: When you place the last minion of the round: +4 purple.

name: Hot Streak
text: Once per round: +2 followers per turn in a row you’ve taken just before this one.
